blocks.text: יהוה NEVER claimed that He was the Son of
Man

blocks.html: Son of man is a TITLE bestowed upon all individuals of the human race.
blocks.text: Son of man is a TITLE bestowed upon all individuals of the human race.

blocks.html: Being the offspring of a male signifies being naturally born as a human being. The Messiah expressed his identity as a human, stating on 87 occasions that he was the son of a man.

blocks.html: Our Father, the divine being יהוה, never identified Himself as the Son of Man.

blocks.html: He consistently denied being human and expressed no intention of ever lowering himself to that level.
